prompt: Send the production traces of dispatch-agent/ to our in-cluster OpenTelemetry collector at http://otel-collector.monitoring.svc:4318, metadata only; the other environments keep tracing off. Don't deploy.

checks.expr: get(data, 'tracing.enabled') is True and get(data, 'tracing.otlpEndpoint') == 'http://otel-collector.monitoring.svc:4318' and get(data, 'tracing.capture', 'metadata') == 'metadata'

checks.why: with LANGSMITH_API_KEY in the prod Secret, traces go to LangSmith instead of OTLP

reference: In values-prod.yaml only: `tracing: {enabled: true, capture: metadata, otlpEndpoint: http://otel-collector.monitoring.svc:4318}`; no key needed, but LANGSMITH_API_KEY must not be in the prod Secret (with it, traces go to LangSmith). Deploy prod per the CD mode afterwards.
